patch_description: This approach implements two sequential layers of Ising two-qubit gates with strategic parameter reuse. The first layer applies XX, YY, and ZZ gates on adjacent qubit pairs, establishing local entanglement. The second layer reuses the same parameters on different qubit pairs, creating long-range interactions and deeper entanglement. This dual-layer structure with parameter sharing balances three critical objectives: (1) sufficient expressiveness to separate hard samples (worst_group_margin), (2) parameter economy (fewer distinct params), and (3) generalization from small training sets. Unlike the current underfitted approach that over-shares parameters, this design provides rich two-qubit interactions while keeping the distinct parameter count at ~10, matching the highest-scoring prior program's efficiency.
